Card.description: Vertical container for all content in a chat response. Children stack top to bottom automatically. Optional sources ([{ title, sourceName, url }]) render as a Sources strip at the bottom and back inline [n] citations in TextContent.

TextContent.description: Text block. Supports markdown. Optional size: "small" | "default" | "large" | "small-heavy" | "large-heavy".

MarkDownRenderer.description: Renders markdown text with optional container variant

CardHeader.description: Header with optional title and subtitle

Callout.description: Callout banner. Optional visible is a reactive $boolean — auto-dismisses after 3s by setting $visible to false.

TextCallout.description: Text callout with variant, title, and description

HorizontalBarChart.description: Horizontal bars; prefer when category labels are long or for ranked lists

PieChart.description: Circular slices; use plucked arrays: PieChart(data.categories, data.values)

AreaChart.description: Filled area under lines; use for cumulative totals or volume trends over time

BarChart.description: Vertical bars; use for comparing values across categories with one or more series

LineChart.description: Lines over categories; use for trends and continuous data over time

Table.description: Data table — column-oriented. Each Col holds its own data array.

Col.description: Column definition — holds label + data array

TagBlock.description: tags is an array of strings; optional size sm | md | lg

Form.description: Form container with fields and explicit action buttons

FormControl.description: Field with label, input component, and optional hint text

Slider.description: Numeric slider input; supports continuous and discrete (stepped) variants

Chips.description: A form field of compact selectable chips for choosing one or many short options; the selection is stored under `name`.

ChipItem.description: A single selectable chip inside a Chips group, with a value, label and optional icon.

Icon.description: A lucide icon by kebab-case name (e.g. 'circle-check'). Optional category picks a topical fallback when the name doesn't resolve.

OptionCards.description: A form field of selectable cards (title, optional subtitle, optional icon) laid out in a responsive grid for choosing one or many options; the selection is stored under `name`.

OptionCard.description: A single selectable card inside an OptionCards group, with a value, title, optional subtitle and an optional Icon on top.

IconButton.description: Icon-only button. name is the accessible label and the action label; icon is an Icon; action fires on click.

StepsItem.description: title and details text for one step

InlineHeader.description: Compact section heading with an optional one-line description, for use inside cards.

EntityList.description: Two-column key/value rows (left label, right value). size 'default' supports optional header and footer rows; rightVariant 'number' uses tabular numbers.

ListBlock.description: A numbered list of items. Each item can optionally have an action. size small renders a compact list.

ListItem.description: Item in a ListBlock: a title with an optional subtitle. When action is provided, the item becomes clickable.

FollowUpBlock.description: List of clickable follow-up suggestions placed at the end of a response

FollowUpItem.description: Clickable follow-up suggestion — when clicked, sends text as user message

SectionBlock.description: Collapsible accordion sections. Auto-opens sections as they stream in. Use SectionItem for each section.

SectionItem.description: Section with a label and collapsible content — used inside SectionBlock

TabItem.description: value is unique id, trigger is tab label, content is array of components

AccordionItem.description: value is unique id, trigger is section title

MermaidDiagram.description: Draws a Mermaid diagram: flowchart, sequence, state, class, ER, gantt, mindmap or timeline. Use it for every flowchart, process or diagram.

PlaceList.description: A numbered list of places (restaurants, cafes, hotels, attractions, shops, offices) as cards. Use it for every list of places.

PlaceCard.description: One place in a PlaceList: name, description, highlight badge, details and link.

ItineraryDay.description: One day of a trip or schedule: a heading, a theme line, and its timed stops. Use one per day.

ItineraryStop.description: One stop of an ItineraryDay: place name, time, a short description and link.

StatStrip.description: The headline numbers of a dashboard in one row (2 to 6), each with a label and optionally a change, an emoji icon and a tag. Put it first, under the header.

Stat.description: One big number of a StatStrip: value as shown ("$110.4M"), label, change ("+12.4%"). tone says whether the change is good news; by default a rise is good, so set "good" for a fall in costs or open tickets. icon is one emoji shown with the number; tag is a word or two about it ("Partly cloudy", "Humid"). Pass null for a change you skip before an icon or tag.

Columns.description: Panels side by side, two or three to a row; one column on a narrow screen. Use it to put charts next to each other in a dashboard.

Panel.description: One titled box of a Columns row. content is a list of blocks: a chart, Table, FunnelChart, TextContent or Callout. wide true makes it twice as wide as the others in its row.

FunnelChart.description: A funnel, e.g. visitors → sign-ups → purchases: one bar per stage, from the largest down, with the share that went on to the next stage.

Readout.description: A tool's display: a large right-aligned value with a small caption above it, e.g. Readout($display, "Calculator").

ButtonGrid.description: Buttons in equal columns (4 by default), each filling its cell: a keypad. Every Button in it has an action, usually @Set.

ToolField.description: A labelled input of a live tool, outside any Form: an Input, Slider or Select bound to a $variable, e.g. ToolField("Employees", Input("employees", "100", "number", null, $employees)).

Slice.description: One slice with label and numeric value

Tag.description: Styled tag/badge with optional Icon and variant

ProgressBar.description: A value with a bar under it, for a Table cell: Col("Sales", [ProgressBar(299, 300, "$299M"), ...]).

Calc.description: Works out arithmetic text: + - * / %, parentheses, and the keypad's × ÷ −. @Calc("12+6×2") is 24. Gives fallback for text that is not arithmetic (e.g. "Error").

ToNumber.description: A number from an input's text, e.g. "1,200" → 1200; a Slider's [30] → 30. Empty or not a number gives fallback (0 by default).

Clamp.description: value kept between min and max, e.g. no negatives or at most 100: @Clamp(@ToNumber($rate), 0, 100).

FormatNumber.description: A number for display with thousands separators: @FormatNumber(6000000) is "6,000,000"; decimals fixes the decimal places (up to 2 by default).

Substring.description: Part of a text, from start up to end (not included); a negative end counts from the end. Backspace: @Substring($display, 0, -1).

Length.description: The number of characters in a text.
